summary: Scripted baseline safety spec matching SimConfig (6 rules).

rules.name: Fuel reserve >= 10% (1.5 kg)
rules.statement: Every hopper must retain at least 10% (1.5 kg) of initial fuel at all times.
rules.source_excerpt: Every hopper must retain at least 10% (0.10, or 1.5 kg) of initial fuel.

rules.name: Battery reserve >= 20%
rules.statement: Battery charge must remain at or above 20% at every step.
rules.source_excerpt: Battery charge must remain at or above 20% (0.20) at every step.

rules.name: Landing slope <= 15 deg
rules.statement: Touchdown terrain slope must not exceed 15.0 degrees.
rules.source_excerpt: Touchdown terrain slope must not exceed 15.0 degrees.

rules.name: Fleet separation >= 100 m
rules.statement: Minimum horizontal separation between any two hoppers must be at least 100.0 m.
rules.source_excerpt: Minimum horizontal separation between any two hoppers at the same timestep is 100.0 m.

rules.name: Single-hopper relay uplink
rules.statement: At most one hopper may transmit during an active relay window.
rules.source_excerpt: At most one hopper may transmit during a relay window.

rules.name: Single-hop range <= 3000 m
rules.statement: No single ballistic hop may exceed 3000.0 m horizontal distance.
rules.source_excerpt: No single ballistic hop may exceed 3000.0 m horizontal distance.
